name: Your Package Has Arrived
objectiveText: Deliver Eldrun's misplaced package . Misplaced Package (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
A little delivery quest that only grants 50 XP and 8 copper, reminiscent of the level 1 deliveries in Stormwind City. This quest was most likely added as a little introduction to the new Alliance Shaman trainer's location.

The quest is started by a pile of boxes in [b]Tinker Town[/b], and it's turned in to [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=258098/eldrun-stormbreaker#map]Eldrun[/url] in [b]The Forlorn Cavern[/b] standing right in front of the big puddle over there.

[i]P.S. The [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/npc=5162/tansy-puddlefizz#map]fishing vendor[/url] in the building opposite to Eldrun sells [item=6326] and [item=6328], neither of which are supplied by any vendor in Darnassus nor in Stormwind, so perhaps pick those up while you're here...[/i]
